name: connectwise-psa
description: ConnectWise PSA (Manage): tickets, companies, contacts, time, expenses, projects, finance and sales. Read, write, and an interactive ticket card.
long_description:
ConnectWise PSA (Manage) as a local MCP server. Tickets, companies, contacts, configurations, time and expense entries, projects, agreements, invoices, opportunities, members, activities and schedule entries, plus board metadata and read/write escape hatches (cw_api_request, cw_api_write) for the rest of the 1,800+ endpoint REST surface.

Every tool is named cw_* and shows a Title Case name in the client. Read-only tools carry readOnlyHint and can run without a prompt; write tools declare themselves as writes; cw_get_ticket renders an MCP Apps card with an internal-note box on hosts that support it and plain JSON everywhere else.

THIS CONNECTOR WRITES. It can create and update tickets, add ticket notes, and create time and expense entries. The raw read tool cannot issue anything but GET, and cw_api_write refuses DELETE without confirm: true.

This bundle runs on your own machine and holds the ConnectWise credentials there. Automate and Control ship as separate bundles from the same repository.

psa_site.title: PSA site

psa_company_id.title: PSA company id
psa_company_id.description: The company identifier you log in with.

psa_public_key.title: PSA public key
psa_public_key.description: Public key of an API member. Give that member only the permissions these tools need — the connector can create tickets and time entries.

psa_private_key.title: PSA private key
psa_private_key.description: The matching private key. Supply it from your secret manager.

psa_client_id.title: ConnectWise clientId
psa_client_id.description: The developer clientId GUID sent with every request. Issued by ConnectWise; required by the API.
